name: Cozy Coasters
description:
About This Game

Welcome to your new favorite island getaway!

In this cozy, casual take on the theme park genre, you aren't just the park manager - you're the coaster conductor. Leave the stressful physics and complicated track-laying behind. Instead, kick back, expand your island, and enjoy the ride.

Take the Controls

Once a coaster is built, it’s time to ride! Using simple, intuitive Accelerate and Brake controls, it is your job to safely guide your coaster around the track. Punch the gas to ensure you have enough momentum to make it through gravity-defying loops, but feather the brakes over the crests of hills so your passengers don't go flying out of their seats! It’s a relaxing, rhythmic balance of speed and safety.

Build Your Island Paradise

Your island is broken up into beautiful, undiscovered plots of land. Spend your hard-earned ticket money to unlock new areas and reveal the coaster blueprints waiting inside. Construction is stress-free: just fund the track segment-by-segment and watch your new attraction come to life right before your eyes.

Manage & Upgrade

A good coaster is a profitable coaster! Manage your ride's economy - spend your cash to add extra carts, increase passenger capacity, and adjust your ticket prices to find the perfect sweet spot for your income.

Master Every Ride

Completionists rejoice! Every coaster on the island comes with 5 unique mini-achievements. Whether it’s earning $1,000 in ticket sales or safely bringing 100 passengers back to the station without a hitch, completing these goals will earn you up to a prestigious 5-Star rating. Master your current rides to fund the expansion of your island!

Key Features:

  • Cozy Gameplay Loop: Unlock land, build piece-by-piece, upgrade, and ride.

  • Active Riding Mechanics: Manually accelerate and brake to keep your passengers safe and happy.

  • Bite-Sized Management: Simple, satisfying upgrades for carts, passengers, and ticket prices.

  • A Beautiful Island Map: Watch your tranquil island transform as you unlock new plots and build bigger rides.

  • Rewarding Progression: 16 coasters to unlock & master, each with 5 specific challenges per coaster to achieve a perfect 5-star rating.

Sit back, relax, and enjoy the ride!
short_desc: Welcome to your cozy coaster island! Unlock new lands, fund the construction of scenic rollercoasters, and hop in the driver’s seat. Use simple accelerate and brake controls to safely guide your passengers through loops and drops. Upgrade your rides, earn stars, and build a relaxing park paradise!
